title: SAC, IEEE Hyderabad Section is organizing awareness section on The Nasscom AI-Code Sarathi - a free, 4-hour live online AI coding workshop
description:
SAC, IEEE Hyderabad Section is organizing awareness section on The Nasscom AI-Code Sarathi - a free, 4-hour live online AI coding workshop

SAC, IEEE Hyderabad Section is delighted to share an exclusive opportunity for the students: The Nasscom AI-Code Sarathi - a free, 4-hour live online AI coding workshop by Industry mentors.

This program is an industry initiative led by Nasscom, supported by Google. Idealabs is the ecosystem Partner and TalentFarm.ai is the Platform Partner. 
Students will get certification and Colleges to be recognized/certified for AI readiness.

Program Overview:
Format: Live, Hands-on vibe coding workshop
Mentor: Senior Industry Practitioners recommended by Nasscom
Mode: Online, Live trainer based
Duration: 4 Hours
Schedule: Slots can be chosen by college between March9 and March20
Cost: Free

All members are requested to join using the following link
